remarks: Welcome to the desirable Heywood Heights complex, where beautifully landscaped green spaces, a clubhouse, and a sparkling in-ground pool create a wonderful community atmosphere. This spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo features an open living and dining area perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy your private patio and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Both the full bathroom and powder room have been tastefully updated, blending style and comfort seamlessly. With generously sized bedrooms and thoughtful updates throughout, this home is ready to welcome you! Ideal rental with nice updates and great community amenities-don't miss this fantastic opportunity!
